output:
crawling-interval
enable-monitors
ignored-directories
ignored-directories-with-content
ignored-files
index-on-battery
index-on-battery-first-time
index-optical-discs
index-recursive-directories
index-removable-devices
index-single-directories
initial-sleep
low-disk-space-limit
removable-days-threshold
throttle

[D-BUS Service]
Name=org.freedesktop.Tracker3.Miner.Files
Exec=/usr/libexec/tracker-miner-fs-3  
SystemdService=tracker-miner-fs-3.service

# Miner details needed for tracker-control
Path=/org/freedesktop/Tracker3/Miner/Files
NameSuffix=Miner.Files
DisplayName=File System
Comment=File system data miner
